name: Emrock Corporation Limited
about: Emrock Corporation Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. It is involved in the trading of transfer of development rights. It also operates in hospitality sector, as well as engages in solar and energy activities The company was formerly known as Vaghani Techno-Build Limited and changed its name to Emrock Corporation Limited in December 2025. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
